Hello Sir,

emails.subject: Company Retreat, Date Conformed

emails.body:
Hi Sir,

I wanted to ask you if you could handle some tasks for the trip. I wanted you to get in contact with the location we are going on June 19th, just to approve everything we have planned. While you're at it, could you also bring me a list of all the employees you want to give VIP access to by June 22nd, the retreat date?

Thanks,
Event Corridnator
emails.subject: Tasks before the retreat

emails.body:
{!athlete_visit = dom:22,1m}Hey Man!

A major athlete is going to be in town next week and wants to connect with us! I heard the company retreat is next week, but this visit is VERY important. I talked with the planner, and we are going to reschedule the retreat for the week after the week we originally scheduled, and I need you to put the date of the meeting with the athlete on your calander for August 22nd now!

Late notice, but this is BIG!
Thanks,
Executive
emails.subject: In Town and would love to connect

emails.body:
Hello Sir,

I was told that an athlete will be arriving to talk with the company next week! I was told to ask you to create a list of people you want to come to the visit. Also, while you're at it, make sure to contact the people you've selected,letting them know! All this before the visit, of course!

Best,
Company Employee
